children: A Saudi Arabian subsidiary of Kuwait-listed Mabanee Company has signed an agreement to acquire a 17,477-square-metre (sqm) plot in capital Riyadh for 113 million Saudi riyals ($30.1 million), Mabanee said on Sunday.
The company said in a disclosure that it owns a 73 percent stake in the subsidiary acquiring the property.
The land will be developed and invested in to support the company's operational activities.
The transaction value is equivalent to approximately 9.3 million Kuwaiti dinars ($30.1 million).
The disclosure did not identify the subsidiary, location of the plot within Riyadh, proposed development type, total investment or construction schedule.

In May 2026, Zawya Projects had reported that Mabanee’s Saudi projects, developed by subsidiary Shomoul Holding Company, remain on track. The projects include The Avenues-Riyadh; Riyadh Towers and The Avenues – Khobar.
(Writing by SA Kader; Editing by Anoop Menon)

title: Kuwait’s Mabanee unit acquires Riyadh land for $30mln
